cards.card_text: To Daniel he gives the name Belteshazzar, and Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah become Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego.
cards.verse_text: The chief official gave them new names: To Daniel he gave the name Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to Mishael, Meshach; and to Azariah, Abednego.
cards.snippet: …chief official gave them new names: To Daniel he gave the name Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to Mishael, Meshach; and to Azariah, Abednego.

cards.card_text: The king asks Daniel, also called Belteshazzar (Daniel 1:7), if he can tell him what he saw in the dream and its interpretation.
cards.verse_text: The king responded to Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, “Are you able to tell me what I saw in the dream, as well as its interpretation?”

cards.card_text: But at last, in comes Daniel, chief of the magicians, whose name is Belteshazzar after the name of the king's god.
cards.verse_text: But at last, into my presence came Daniel (whose name is Belteshazzar after the name of my god, and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods).
cards.snippet: But at last, into my presence came Daniel (whose name is Belteshazzar after the name of my god, and in whom is the spirit…

cards.card_text: The man's name is Daniel, the one Nebuchadnezzar named Belteshazzar.
cards.verse_text: did this because Daniel, the one he named Belteshazzar, was found to have an extraordinary spirit, as well as knowledge, understanding, and the ability to interpret dreams, explain riddles, and solve difficult problems.
cards.snippet: did this because Daniel, the one he named Belteshazzar, was found to have an extraordinary spirit, as well as knowledge, understanding,…

cards.card_text: A message is revealed to Daniel, also called Belteshazzar, one of the young men taken from Judah to Babylon long ago (Daniel 1:1-7).
cards.verse_text: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia, a message was revealed to Daniel, who was called Belteshazzar.
cards.snippet: …king of Persia, a message was revealed to Daniel, who was called Belteshazzar.
